evidence.name: Screen field: Pre-selected starting value
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Pre-selected starting value" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Pre-selected starting value
sections.description: The value already showing when the screen loads. For List wheels, pick one of your options; for Range wheels, pick any number within the from/to span. Pre-selecting the most common answer reduces friction and prevents accidental empty or extreme submissions — leave it empty only if you truly want nothing chosen up front.
